title: T1 vs DRX Worlds 2022 Game 5
subtitle: A public-safe view of a branch benchmark under an analyst-authored model.
claimBoundary: This does not claim T1 would have won, that a coach was wrong, or that League draft is solved globally. It shows what Derzan found under a declared analyst-authored model, with exact weights and raw traces omitted.
primaryFinding: In the sanitized flagship case, the strongest Derzan branches take Aatrox for T1 at the key divergence points and keep DRX from receiving it in the shown terminal examples.

derzanBranches.label: B1 after Lux ban
derzanBranches.explanation: Top action from Derzan MCTS at this decision point. Greedy baseline denying DRX comfort from Games 1-4. Public-priority baseline preferring Aatrox, Caitlyn, then Varus when legal.

derzanBranches.label: B3 before Viktor
derzanBranches.explanation: Top action from Derzan MCTS at this decision point. Greedy baseline using T1 comfort from Games 1-4. Greedy baseline denying DRX comfort from Games 1-4.
